designationHistory.name: Dungeness Spit Reservation
designationHistory.indexText: President Woodrow Wilson established the Dungeness Spit Reservation by Executive Order 2123; it is now Dungeness National Wildlife Refuge.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Dungeness National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
American Presidency Project: Executive Order 8518—Modification of Executive Order No. 2123 of January 20, 1915, Reserving Certain Public Land as a Native Bird Refuge (Aug 16, 1940)
American Presidency Project: Proclamation 2416, Changing the Names of Certain Federal Wildlife Refuges (July 25, 1940), lists former and new names

review.note: EO 2123, 1915-01-20 (Woodrow Wilson). EO 8518 (Aug. 16, 1940) cites "Executive Order No. 2123 of January 20, 1915 ... known as Dungeness Spit Reservation". Draft signer field held "Executive Order"; President is Wilson.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Dungeness National Wildlife Refuge was established by Executive Order on January 20, 1915 for the land to be “ . . . as a refuge, preserve and breeding ground for native birds. ” The original 226.02 acres were known as the Dungeness Spit Reservation.
